description: This file contains SQL schema definitions, functions, and procedures related to TimescaleDB, including table creation, function definitions for UUID conversion and data cleanup based on TTL, and a stored procedure for time-series data maintenance.

methods.name: to_uuid
methods.description: Converts a varchar entity_id to a UUID format.

methods.name: delete_device_records_from_ts_kv
methods.description: Deletes device records from ts_kv table based on tenant_id, customer_id, and TTL.

methods.name: delete_asset_records_from_ts_kv
methods.description: Deletes asset records from ts_kv table based on tenant_id, customer_id, and TTL.

methods.name: delete_customer_records_from_ts_kv
methods.description: Deletes customer records from ts_kv table based on tenant_id, customer_id, and TTL.

methods.name: cleanup_timeseries_by_ttl
methods.description: Procedures to clean up time-series data based on TTL for tenants, customers, devices, and assets.
